en.text: “Forthe Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

zhSimplified.text: 「因为天国好像家主清早去雇人进他的葡萄园做工，

zhTraditional.text: 「因為天國好像家主清早去雇人進他的葡萄園做工，

en.text: Whenhe had agreed with the laborers for a denarius aday, he sent them into his vineyard.

footnotes.text: 20:2 A denarius is a silver Roman coin worth 1/25th of a Roman aureus. This was a common wage for a day of farm labor.

zhSimplified.text: 和工人讲定一天一钱银子，就打发他们进葡萄园去。

zhTraditional.text: 和工人講定一天一錢銀子，就打發他們進葡萄園去。

en.text: Hewent out about the third hour, andsaw others standing idle in the marketplace.

footnotes.text: 20:3 Time was measured from sunrise to sunset, so the third hour would be about 9:00 a.m.

zhSimplified.text: 约在巳初出去，看见市上还有闲站的人，

zhTraditional.text: 約在巳初出去，看見市上還有閒站的人，

en.text: Hesaid to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

zhSimplified.text: 就对他们说：『你们也进葡萄园去，所当给的，我必给你们。』他们也进去了。

zhTraditional.text: 就對他們說：『你們也進葡萄園去，所當給的，我必給你們。』他們也進去了。

en.text: Againhe went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, anddid likewise.

zhSimplified.text: 约在午正和申初又出去，也是这样行。

zhTraditional.text: 約在午正和申初又出去，也是這樣行。

en.text: Aboutthe eleventh hour hewent out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

zhSimplified.text: 约在酉初出去，看见还有人站在那里，就问他们说：『你们为什么整天在这里闲站呢？』

zhTraditional.text: 約在酉初出去，看見還有人站在那裏，就問他們說：『你們為甚麼整天在這裏閒站呢？』

en.text: “Theysaid to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “Hesaid to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：『因为没有人雇我们。』他说：『你们也进葡萄园去。』

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：『因為沒有人雇我們。』他說：『你們也進葡萄園去。』

en.text: “Whenevening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

zhSimplified.text: 到了晚上，园主对管事的说：『叫工人都来，给他们工钱，从后来的起，到先来的为止。

zhTraditional.text: 到了晚上，園主對管事的說：『叫工人都來，給他們工錢，從後來的起，到先來的為止。』

en.text: “Whenthose who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

zhSimplified.text: 约在酉初雇的人来了，各人得了一钱银子。

zhTraditional.text: 約在酉初雇的人來了，各人得了一錢銀子。

en.text: Whenthe first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

zhSimplified.text: 及至那先雇的来了，他们以为必要多得；谁知也是各得一钱。

zhTraditional.text: 及至那先雇的來了，他們以為必要多得；誰知也是各得一錢。

en.text: Whenthey received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

zhSimplified.text: 他们得了，就埋怨家主说：

zhTraditional.text: 他們得了，就埋怨家主說：

en.text: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

zhSimplified.text: 『我们整天劳苦受热，那后来的只做了一小时，你竟叫他们和我们一样吗？』

zhTraditional.text: 『我們整天勞苦受熱，那後來的只做了一小時，你竟叫他們和我們一樣嗎？』

en.text: “Buthe answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’ t you agree with me for a denarius?

zhSimplified.text: 家主回答其中的一人说：『朋友，我不亏负你，你与我讲定的不是一钱银子吗？

zhTraditional.text: 家主回答其中的一人說：『朋友，我不虧負你，你與我講定的不是一錢銀子嗎？

en.text: Takethat which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

zhSimplified.text: 拿你的走吧！我给那后来的和给你一样，这是我愿意的。

zhTraditional.text: 拿你的走吧！我給那後來的和給你一樣，這是我願意的。

en.text: Isn’tit lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

zhSimplified.text: 我的东西难道不可随我的意思用吗？因为我作好人，你就红了眼吗？』

zhTraditional.text: 我的東西難道不可隨我的意思用嗎？因為我作好人，你就紅了眼嗎？』

en.text: Sothe last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

zhSimplified.text: 这样，那在后的，将要在前；在前的，将要在后了。」 （可10·32—34；路18·31—34）

footnotes.text: - 20:16 有古卷加：因为被召的人多，选上的人少。

zhTraditional.text: 這樣，那在後的，將要在前；在前的，將要在後了。 」 （可10‧32－34；路18‧31－34）

footnotes.text: - 20:16 有古卷加：因為被召的人多，選上的人少。

en.text: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣上耶路撒冷去的时候，在路上把十二个门徒带到一边，对他们说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌上耶路撒冷去的時候，在路上把十二個門徒帶到一邊，對他們說：

en.text: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

zhSimplified.text: 「看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交给祭司长和文士。他们要定他死罪，

zhTraditional.text: 「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交給祭司長和文士。他們要定他死罪，

en.text: andwill hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

zhSimplified.text: 又交给外邦人，将他戏弄，鞭打，钉在十字架上；第三日他要复活。」 （可10·35—45）

zhTraditional.text: 又交給外邦人，將他戲弄，鞭打，釘在十字架上；第三日他要復活。」 （可10‧35－45）

en.text: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，西庇太儿子的母亲同她两个儿子上前来拜耶稣，求他一件事。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，西庇太兒子的母親同她兩個兒子上前來拜耶穌，求他一件事。

en.text: He said to her, “Whatdo you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你要什么呢？」她说：「愿你叫我这两个儿子在你国里，一个坐在你右边，一个坐在你左边。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你要甚麼呢？」她說：「願你叫我這兩個兒子在你國裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。」

en.text: But Jesus answered, “Youdon’ t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「你们不知道所求的是什么；我将要喝的杯，你们能喝吗？」他们说：「我们能。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「你們不知道所求的是甚麼；我將要喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？」他們說：「我們能。」

en.text: He said to them, “Youwill indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我所喝的杯，你们必要喝；只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以赐的，乃是我父为谁预备的，就赐给谁。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我所喝的杯，你們必要喝；只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是我父為誰預備的，就賜給誰。」

en.text: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

zhSimplified.text: 那十个门徒听见，就恼怒他们弟兄二人。

zhTraditional.text: 那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒他們弟兄二人。

en.text: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “Youknow that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣叫了他们来，说：「你们知道外邦人有君王为主治理他们，有大臣操权管束他们。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌叫了他們來，說：「你們知道外邦人有君王為主治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。

en.text: Itshall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be yourservant.

footnotes.text: 20:26 TR reads “let him be” instead of “shall be”

zhSimplified.text: 只是在你们中间，不可这样；你们中间谁愿为大，就必作你们的用人；

zhTraditional.text: 只是在你們中間，不可這樣；你們中間誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；

en.text: Whoeverdesires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

zhSimplified.text: 谁愿为首，就必作你们的仆人。

zhTraditional.text: 誰願為首，就必作你們的僕人。

en.text: evenas the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

zhSimplified.text: 正如人子来，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，并且要舍命，作多人的赎价。」 （可10·46—52；路18·35—43）

zhTraditional.text: 正如人子來，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命，作多人的贖價。」 （可10‧46－52；路18‧35－43）

en.text: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

zhSimplified.text: 他们出耶利哥的时候，有极多的人跟随他。

zhTraditional.text: 他們出耶利哥的時候，有極多的人跟隨他。

en.text: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

zhSimplified.text: 有两个瞎子坐在路旁，听说是耶稣经过，就喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 有兩個瞎子坐在路旁，聽說是耶穌經過，就喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」

en.text: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

zhSimplified.text: 众人责备他们，不许他们作声；他们却越发喊着说：「主啊，大卫的子孙，可怜我们吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人責備他們，不許他們作聲；他們卻越發喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」

en.text: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “Whatdo you want me to do for you?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣就站住，叫他们来，说：「要我为你们做什么？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌就站住，叫他們來，說：「要我為你們做甚麼？」

en.text: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：「主啊，要我们的眼睛能看见！」

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：「主啊，要我們的眼睛能看見！」

en.text: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣就动了慈心，把他们的眼睛一摸，他们立刻看见，就跟从了耶稣。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌就動了慈心，把他們的眼睛一摸，他們立刻看見，就跟從了耶穌。
